description.value: Bozzini's has been a Chilliwack fixture since April 1982, drawing roughly 100,000 guests a year with an eclectic, largely house-made menu spanning half-pound burgers, AAA steaks cut in-house, pastas, seafood, souvlaki, and more — including the restaurant's own Caesar dressing and BBQ sauce unchanged since opening day. The no-gimmicks, no-coupons philosophy reflects a decades-long confidence in straightforward quality at fair value. An intimate upstairs lounge regularly hosts live music acts, making it a natural choice for a post-ride evening meal and show.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence of an active, long-running restaurant: open since April 1982 and with upcoming live events in June, July, and October 2026, confirming current operation. Phone (604-792-0744) and address (#4-45379 Hocking Ave, Chilliwack, BC V2P 6Z6) are sourced from the website since OSM carries neither. One cyclist-relevant amenity is confirmed: the group menu explicitly labels a vegetarian pasta option; no bike parking, washroom, takeout, or Wi-Fi details appear anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address inconsistency within the website: the footer consistently shows '#4-45379 Hocking Ave' while the contact page and events subpages show '4-45739 Hocking Ave' (street number 45379 vs 45739). Correct address should be verified on the ground or via Google Maps.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active full-service restaurant in Chilliwack with 40+ years of operation and confirmed upcoming 2026 events — a solid meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Group menu explicitly labels 'Baked Lasagne with Meat Sauce or Marinara (vegetarian)' as a vegetarian option

wow_evidence: open since April 1982 and drawing roughly 100,000 guests a year; upstairs lounge with regular live music
